_note: The master switch is NOT in this file: it is the repository variable SOCIAL_MODE (off | dry | live). Unset or off means nothing runs. A line can also be paused here with enabled:false. reply: none (default, nothing is posted under the post; the owner may add the link by hand) | pointer (an automatic reply without any link) | link (an automatic reply with txfolio.xyz, costs $0.20 each). Line new (NEW ON TXFLOW) is event-driven: no posting hour, at most maxPerDay posts; it is enabled since 2026-11-27 at the owner's request. Plan: two scheduled posts a day (up, then funding; down only on a day funding did not post: onlyIfNoPost) plus line new whenever it has news; dailyCap 4 = 2 + 2. funding must close (utcHour + windowMinutes) before down opens.
